name: Sub-Zero assesses Cassie's squad
description: After defeating the young fighters, Sub-Zero reveals that the Lin Kuei mission was a training exercise arranged with Johnny Cage. He tells Cassie, Jacqui, Takeda, and Kung Jin that they show promise but will fail unless they begin functioning as a team. This Event records the assessment outcome rather than treating the exercise as a real breakdown in Earthrealm-Lin Kuei relations.
